record.question: To be named Scheduled Banks, banks have to be registered with:
record.explanation: Answer B: RBI. A scheduled bank is included in the Second Schedule to the RBI Act, 1934. Reference: https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/FAQView.aspx?Id=92. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
